```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

### Annual updating steps:
### Set most current year
YEAR <-  2025 #YEAR ENDING SPRING DATA, so CSV with same year as selected
g <- 8  #last grade to show on plot, or use "ELA3_8"
###

years_back <- YEAR - 2021 #4 years back, being we have ELA since 2021
  
######## Load and clean the SPENDING data
spending_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/SPENDING%2CENROLLMENT/slfs_essa_financial_merged_thru2025.csv"
spending_raw <- 
  read_csv(spending_url)

# Clean variables and filter for years 2021-YEAR
spending_clean <- spending_raw %>%
  mutate(
    YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR),
    PK12_Enrollment = as.numeric(PK12_Enrollment),
    SWD_Enrollment = as.numeric(SWD_Enrollment),
    Special_Education_Expenditures = as.numeric(Special_Education_Expenditures),
    Special_Education_Expenditures_PerSWD = as.numeric(Special_Education_Expenditures_PerSWD),
    Special_Education_Expenditures_PerPupil = as.numeric(Special_Education_Expenditures_PerPupil)
  ) %>%
  filter(YEAR >= 2021 & YEAR <= YEAR)
## remove Entity_Name because we'll use the cleaner names from the ELA data
spending_clean["ENTITY_NAME"] <- NULL

# Format BEDS Code to prevent scientific notation in JSON serialization
spending_clean$ENTITY_CD <- format(spending_clean$ENTITY_CD, scientific = FALSE)

######## Load and clean ELA data
### Read ELA data
  csv_file1 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR, ".csv")
  csv_file2 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR-1, ".csv")
  csv_file3 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR-2, ".csv")
  csv_file4 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR-3, ".csv")
  csv_file5 <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/ELA/DATA_ELA-SPRING-", YEAR-4, ".csv")

df1 <- read_csv(csv_file1)
df2 <- read_csv(csv_file2)
df3 <- read_csv(csv_file3)
df4 <- read_csv(csv_file4)
df5 <- read_csv(csv_file5)  
# combine
shared_data <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5)

## KEEP Only Keep Spring (year-end) Data
shared_data<-shared_data[(shared_data$SEASON == "Spring"),]

# Only keep District and County Data
## (old) Only Keep District Data
shared_data <- shared_data[shared_data$ENTITY_TYPE == "DISTRICT",]

## Only Keep Subgroups to be used - SWD
shared_data<-shared_data[(shared_data$SUBGROUP_NAME == "Students with Disabilities"),]

###### Only Keep All ELA tested Grades (ELA3_8) we want on this report
## Based on top selections, currently: grade8 for 2025, 7 for 2024, 6 for 2023, 5 for 2022, 4 for 2021

# Set grade sequence to show on plot (YEAR-0, YEAR-1... YEAR-4)
offsets <- 0:years_back
valid_offsets <- offsets[g == "ELA3_8" | (g - offsets) >= 3]
# Create the final list of objects exactly like the OJS structure
grade_sequence <- lapply(valid_offsets, function(offset) {
  list(
    year = YEAR - offset,
    assessment = if (g == "ELA3_8") "ELA3_8" else paste0("ELA", g - offset)
  )
})
# Filter shared_data with years/grades we want 
keep_rows <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(grade_sequence, function(g_entry) {
  shared_data$ASSESSMENT_NAME == g_entry$assessment & shared_data$YEAR == g_entry$year
}))
shared_data <- shared_data[keep_rows, ]

## Remove rows with NA Prof_Pct rates (to prevent rows with missing counts from being included but NA on plots)
##shared_data <- shared_data %>% 
##  filter(!is.na(Prof_Pct)) %>% 
##  dplyr::arrange(Prof_Pct, NotProf_Pct)

## Remove all columns not used - lessen load to frontend/users, reduce html output size
shared_data <- shared_data %>% select(-c(PCT_NOT_TESTED, NotProf_Pct, NotTested_Pct, SEASON, TOTAL_COUNT))

## Remove NYC districts for this plot - they are not currently included in the spending data csv
shared_data <- shared_data[!startsWith(tolower(shared_data$ENTITY_NAME), "nyc geo"), ]

## format ENTITY_CD
shared_data$ENTITY_CD <- format(shared_data$ENTITY_CD, scientific = FALSE)

## Remove col 1, ENTITY NAME
shared_data["...1"] <- NULL

####### Merge them
spending_ela_merged <- shared_data %>%
  inner_join(`spending_clean`, by = c("ENTITY_CD", "YEAR"))

# Pass databases to Observable JS
ojs_define(df_to_js = spending_ela_merged)
ojs_define(gradeSequence = grade_sequence)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// Guard function matching DistrictELAGrowth.qmd toolbar architecture
function guard(fn, options = {}, countyView) {
  const {
    submitLabel = "Submit",
    resetLabel = "Reset",
    required = false,
    resubmit = true,
    width = "100%",
    justify = "start"
  } = options;
  
  const onSubmit = () => {
    value = input.value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
    wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  const onReset = () => {
    input.value = value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
  };
  const onInnerInputCapture = () => {
    invalid = true;
    submit.disabled = true;
  };
  const onInnerInput = e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    submit.disabled = false;
    reset.disabled = false;
  };
  const submit = htl.html`<button ${ { disabled: !resubmit && !required, onclick: onSubmit } } class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">${submitLabel}</button>`;
  const reset = htl.html`<button ${ { disabled: true, onclick: onReset } } class=\"btn btn-secondary btn-sm\">${resetLabel}</button>`;
  const footer = htl.html`
    <div>
      <hr style="padding:0;margin:10px 0">
      <div style="display:flex;gap:1ch;justify-style: ${justify} ">
        ${submit}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  const template = inputs => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "input-toolbar";
    row.append(countyView);
    (Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : Object.values(inputs))
      .forEach(input => row.append(input));
    const container = document.createElement("div");
    container.style.cssText = "width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box";
    container.append(row, footer);
    return container;
  };
  const input = fn({ submit, reset, footer, template, onSubmit, onReset });
  let invalid = !!input.querySelector(":invalid");
  submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInputCapture, { capture: true });
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInput);
  let value = required ? undefined : input.value;
  const wrapper = htl.html`<div style="width: ${width} ">${input}`;
  wrapper.addEventListener("submit", onSubmit);
  return Object.defineProperty(wrapper, "value", {
    get: () => value,
    set: v => { input.value = v }
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
function stackedBarChart(longData) {

  return Plot.plot({
    //className: "ELAgrowth-plot",
    //width,
    //height,
    width: 1000,
    height: 575,
    marginLeft: 80,
    marginBottom: 50,
    //title: chartTitle,
    
    x: { label: null, domain: [...new Set(longData.map(d => d.label))]},
    y: { label: "# Students", grid: true, labelArrow: false,
  labelAnchor: "center", dx: 100},
    color: {
      domain: ["Proficient", "Not Proficient", "Not Tested"],
      range: ["#2F7F73", "#D95C5C", "#B7BDC4"],
      legend: true
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([0]),
      Plot.barY(longData, Plot.stackY({
        x: "label",
        y: "count",
        fill: "category",
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.category}: ${d.count}\n${d.pct != null ? `(${d.pct.toFixed(1)}%)\n(${d.pct2.toFixed(1)}% of Tested only)` : ""}`
      }))
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// update - data for Spending Plot (shared_dataFiltered) basedon user inputs
shared_dataFiltered = {
  if (!inputSels) return [];
  const district = inputSels.district.trim().toUpperCase();
  return shared_data
    .filter(d => d.ENTITY_NAME.toUpperCase() === district)
    .sort((a, b) => Number(a.YEAR) - Number(b.YEAR));
}

// Preprocess accumulation dataset for Waterfall Chart
waterfallData = {
  let acc = 0;
  return shared_dataFiltered.map(d => {
    const annual = Number(d.Special_Education_Expenditures) || 0;
    const yStart = acc;
    acc += annual;
    return {
      ...d,
      YEAR: String(d.YEAR),
      annual,
      yStart,
      yEnd: acc
    };
  });
}

// 1. Calculated Cumulative SPED Spending (2021-YEAR)
cumulativeTotal = {
  if (!inputSels || shared_dataFiltered.length === 0) return 0;
  const years = [2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025];
  let sum = 0;
  years.forEach(y => {
    const row = shared_dataFiltered.find(d => Number(d.YEAR) === y);
    if (row && row.Special_Education_Expenditures) {
      sum += +row.Special_Education_Expenditures;
    }
  });
  return sum;
}

// 2. Extract 2025 SPED spending per Pupil
spedPerPupil2025 = {
  if (!inputSels || shared_dataFiltered.length === 0) return 0;
  const row = shared_dataFiltered.find(d => Number(d.YEAR) === 2025);
  return (row && row.Special_Education_Expenditures_PerPupil) ? +row.Special_Education_Expenditures_PerPupil : 0;
}

Enrollment2025 = {
  if (!inputSels || shared_dataFiltered.length === 0) return 0;
  const row = shared_dataFiltered.find(d => Number(d.YEAR) === 2025);
  return (row && row.PK12_Enrollment) ? +row.PK12_Enrollment : 0;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// update - data for ELA Plot (shared_dataFiltered_ELA) based on user inputs
shared_dataFiltered_ELA = {
  if (!inputSels) return [];
  const district_ela = inputSels.district.trim().toUpperCase();
  return shared_data
    .filter(d => d.ENTITY_NAME.toUpperCase() === district_ela &&
    gradeSequence.some(g => Number(g.year) === Number(d.YEAR) && g.assessment === d.ASSESSMENT_NAME))
    .sort((a, b) => Number(a.YEAR) - Number(b.YEAR));
}

// label for the assessment, used on the x-axis
gradeLabel = assessment => assessment === "ELA3_8"
  ? "All Grades 3-8"
  : `Grade ${assessment.replace("ELA", "")}`
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// ELA plot.  Subgroup and assesment will never actually change being there's not user input for them
function subgroupRows(subgroupName) {

  const byYear = [...gradeSequence]
    .sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year)
    .map(({ year, assessment }) => {
      const row = shared_dataFiltered_ELA.find(d =>
        Number(d.YEAR) === Number(year) &&
        d.ASSESSMENT_NAME === assessment &&
        d.SUBGROUP_NAME === subgroupName
      );

      return {
        YEAR: year,
        label: `${year}\n${gradeLabel(assessment)}`,
        Prof_Count: row ? +row.Prof_Count : 0,
        NotProf_Count: row ? +row.NotProf_Count : 0,
        NOT_TESTED: row ? +row.NOT_TESTED : 0,
        Prof_Pct: row ? +row.Prof_Pct : null,
        NotProf_Pct: row ? +row.NotProf_Pct : null,
        PER_PROF: row ? +row.PER_PROF : null
      };
    });

  // console.log("subgroupRows - byYear:", byYear);

  const result = byYear.flatMap(d => [
    { label: d.label, YEAR: d.YEAR, category: "Proficient", count: d.Prof_Count, pct: d.Prof_Pct, pct2: d.PER_PROF },
    { label: d.label, YEAR: d.YEAR, category: "Not Proficient", count: d.NotProf_Count, pct: null },
    { label: d.label, YEAR: d.YEAR, category: "Not Tested", count: d.NOT_TESTED, pct: null }
  ]);

  // console.log("subgroupRows flatMap - result:", result);

  return result;
}
```
